targets.query:
from(bucket: "model_comparison")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "metric_results")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.model_type != "predicted")
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value", "model_type", "experiment_id"])
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["_field"],
    columnKey: ["model_type"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> sort(columns: ["_field"], desc: true)

panels.description: Полная модель (full) и сжатая compressed — исторические замеры, сделанные в Kaggle; реактивная линия (predicted) пересчитывается при выборе параметра/значения в переменных сверху или при движении ползунков на фронте (iframe var-param_*).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "model_comparison")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "metric_results")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.model_type == "full" or r.model_type == "compressed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "${metric_choice}")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value", "model_type"])
  |> group(columns: ["model_type"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

panels.title: ${metric_choice}: full vs compressed + реактивный прогноз ($param_name = $param_value)

list.definition:
from(bucket: "model_comparison")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "metric_results")
  |> keep(columns: ["_field"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "_field")

list.definition:
from(bucket: "model_comparison")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "metric_results" and r.model_type == "predicted")
  |> keys()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.key =~ /^cfg_/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: strings.trimPrefix(v: r.key, prefix: "cfg_") }))
  |> distinct(column: "_value")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "metric_results" and r.model_type == "predicted")
